messages:
Samira Ali: Hi team, starting parental leave on 2025-06-01 and planning a two-week trip to visit family overseas in July. I have questions about payroll continuation and health benefits while I'm temporarily out of the country.

Jordan (People Ops): Congrats Samira! Payroll continues per normal for Redwood-paid leave. Health benefits remain active for the duration of paid/unpaid leave per your leave type. If you're overseas for <90 days, medical coverage through our US plan usually persists, but medical providers outside the network may need pre-approval for direct billing.

Oliver (Benefits): If you anticipate ongoing care that requires provider billing abroad, submit the expected out-of-network provider info to benefits@redwood.com before travel. We can provide a letter of coverage and advise on claim submission.

Samira Ali: Thanks. Any changes to payroll deductions (401k/commuter) while on leave?

Jordan (People Ops): Deductions that are payroll-based (401k, commuter pre-tax) pause if you're on unpaid leave. If it's paid leave, deductions continue. We'll compute any employer match implications during reconciliation.

PayrollBot: Note: If you go on unpaid leave and continue benefits by COBRA or direct pay, you'll receive an invoice from HR Benefits for the employee portion.

Sam (Engineering): Also, if you plan to travel long-term, please confirm where you'll be working from if any. Tax residency can get complicated.

Jordan (People Ops): Good point. If you remain an employee but perform any work while abroad, we need to evaluate tax and employment law. For short visits while on leave just for family, that typically isn't an issue, but don't work.

Samira Ali: Understood — this trip is personal only. For childcare coverage while I'm away, can we set up a temporary backup caregiver subsidy?

Oliver (Benefits): We have a Emergency/Short-term Care fund that can provide up to $1,000 for one-off childcare needs. Apply via the internal benefits form and tag "emergency-care". Approvals are quick.

Jordan (People Ops): Action items: Samira to send travel dates and confirm no work during leave; Oliver to send benefits form link; Payroll to flag deductions if leave type changes.

PeopleOpsBot: Ticket created: LEAVE-9001 - "Samira Ali - leave travel and benefits check". Jordan assigned.

Samira Ali: Sending dates now. Appreciate the clarity! :pray:
